reviews.comment: Dr. Hilty is a decent professor, though lectures can be hard to follow. His help sessions and office hours are very helpful, exams are mostly calculation-based with a cheat sheet allowed, and I scored above a 90 even without the curve. He also encourages questions and is always willing to help.

Anyone who says it's a discipline thing and not a prof thing, is trolling you. the homework and slides are maybe 20% of the content on the real exam and I can confidently say I knew the material on those well and yet it just didn't matter. You won't fail this class because of the curve but you won't have fun.
He wasn't really interesting and skim through many of the important topics. Homework didn't help at all and found them useless for the exams.

People need to take charge of their learning. This class was an introduction to the subject and could have been much more intensive. Studying does make a difference as you must understand concepts; most exams were "plug&chug," except for a few questions needing deeper thought. Homework and reviews are KEY. Dr. Hilty was not the problem.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Hilty spends half of the lecture rambling about random topics and doesn't explain them clearly. The homework's are useless for understanding the concepts. He is a tough exam grader and doesn't give much partial credit.

Most of these reviews paint Dr. Hilty as the key contributor to their low scores when in reality, their own lack of motivation and self-discipline is their GPA's worst enemy. 20% of the grade is participation (homeworks and iClicker). Exams are much easier than homeworks. Hilty also provides practice problems that really prepare you for the exams.

Absolute horrible professor, and is extremely unhelpful. Classes make no sense, and is pointless to study for exams. Best lecture of the semester was one with a substitute professor, who is known for not being great, yet infinitely better than Hilty.
Avoid at all costs. I cannot write here words that can describe how much I dislike this professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: This guy does not care about the fact our exam averages were consistently in the low 50s. Our final average was a 43. Clearly nobody learned anything from this class unless they also had no life outside of class. Curves heavy but truthfully, not worth your time taking. Go actually learn w someone else
not worth taking. please avoid if possible. i have never taken a more nauseating class in my life
I truly do not think studying or not studying will make a difference on any of the exams you take. Avoid at all costs if possible. Not worth the gpa drop.

How do you get a job as a professor at tamu and what are the qualifications needed because I'm trying to understand how a professor so bad at teaching and making exams somehow came to be teaching one of the hardest courses in my degree plan

you can tell he's a nice guy irl but as a professor he's just not very good at his job. avoid at all costs if you can, his exams were insane and only 20% matched up to actual class problems and slides. the rest is random stuff he pulled out of his own phd level brain

guy below me doesn't know what he's talking about or is the alleged relative he had in his class. worst professor i've ever taken and genuinely never seen so many people confused about a class in my life. if you take this man good luck.

He makes his exams pretty easy, and the class isn't hard if you study and go to class. I liked his lectures  and thought he explained it pretty well. He offers help sessions if you have questions and he's very nice.
I know nothing about pchem and with the way he teaches, you would think he also knows nothing.

Awful at lectures, awful at teaching, and the exams were all failing (around a flat 50) for our class. Huge curve saved my life (usually 20-30 points of curve) and despite not learning a single thing from this class I did enjoy how the exams were literally just 50 minutes of me role playing as a physicist.

Lectures are very boring and don't really make sense. I recommend reviewing the homework solutions (which are completion grades btw) and the test review slides he gives in order to prep for exams. iClicker is used for class participation.

Take anyone else. Homework is completion. 3 exams + final. He has a heavy accent and doesn't teach material well. I-clicker participation questions each class, you must attend. Textbook isn't even that helpful. Terrible class. Hard content and even harder professor.

Professor Hilty is a nice guy, but his lectures can be difficult to follow. Staying on top of the material and using resources like unstuck ai alongside the textbook is key to succeeding in this class.

This class is hard but Hilty makes it worse, his lecture are absolutely useless and the book is even more confusing. He also grades very different between people and gives little to no partial credit. On a good note exam reviews were similar to the exams.

Dr. Hilty himself is nice person, but he doesn't explain things very well. His lectures move at a steady pace but the content itself is complicated and he doesn't make it any more clear. The exams and quizzes weigh extremely heavy on your grade, so study best you can because messing up badly for even one quiz could be catastrophic for your grade.
Knows his stuff but is a very poor lecturer. If you know the content you are fine but otherwise you are screwed. Take someone else.
the prof seems so nice but its so hard to understand what he's trying to teach and what he's saying

Prof Hilty is such a nice man, very knowledgeable, and I enjoyed getting to know him. However, he is not a skilled teacher and struggles to control the class. There is mandatory online homework, the IClicker app for attendance and in-class questions, and biweekly quizzes and two exams. If you struggle with chem he is probably not for you.

Hilty is one of the worst profs I had. He is smart but his lectures are useless(But he takes participation grades), he doesn't explain where he is getting things. His Tutoring, TA's review videos, and Extra credit carried me through the year, and are the only reasons that I am not going to fail this class.

I actually enjoyed taking chem with Dr. Hilty. Our class genuinely cared about him because of his kind nature and his ability to joke with the class. He also has a good lecture pace that is easy to keep up with. Most professors don't care about CHEM 107, but it always felt like Dr. Hilty truly cared about us and wanted the best for us.

Nice guy, but awful teacher. He makes the lectures as unclear as humanly possible. He overexplains massively. Attendance is needed due to iclicker questions and the fact that the lectures slides are very unclear. Highly do not recommend. Has a very profound stutter and accent.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He was a great teacher for 107. All it takes is paying attention and reviewing after to do well in his class.

Dr Hilty is a nice guy and genuinely cares about his students. He is incredibly knowledgeable, and he teaches the concepts well. The quizzes can be sometimes difficult, but he gives plenty of extra credit and the TA review sessions were very helpful.

Dr. Hility is not a bad professor imo and his accent isn't hard to understand. His lectures are very long and honestly boring at times especially since he goes into specific details. The only way you will get an A is if you do the clickers, do the review sessions, watch chem videos and do khan academy problems, and do the owl homework.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Hilty barely explains what he's doing and why he's doing it. I'm already not good at chem, and Hilty doesn't really make it better. The quizzes barely line up with what's on the homework and lectures, so you can definitely lose a lot of points there.

He gets too much criticism. Even though his accent may be hard to understand, if you don't zone out of his lectures, you will do well because he goes in depth and i believe that everyone just zones out of his lectures because of his hard accent. Also his homework helps greatly!

Hilty is one of the worst profs I have every had.He is smart but his lectures are useless(But he takes participation grades), he doesn't explain where he is getting things or why he is doing things with certain variables Tutoring and his TA's review videos carried me through the year, and are the only reasons that I am not going to fail this class.
Very string accent. Knows a lot. Has a hard time conveying his knowledge

This is my first ever rate because this class was by far the hardest class I've taken in my life, I'm not good at chemistry, and professor Hilty made it even more difficult. Lectures and HWs are okay, but quizzes and exams were the hardest part of the course, quizzes were way harder than what we saw on the lecture, choose another professor!

Hilty is really hard to understand and his lectures are very unclear. He will take 5 seconds to explain the concept and then spend 20 minutes asking us to do iClicker questions without explaining the answers at the end. The quizzes are difficult, but if you get a good SI it helps.

If you can avoid Hilty, do it. He is a smart guy, but not meant to teach intro chem. He overcomplicates it heavily. I ended up not going to lectures any more and suffered a bad attendance grade because it became pointless to go to his lectures. He constantly explains simple things in a much more difficult manner and confuses a lot of the students.

Hilty is very lecture heavy and his lectures are also very had to follow. He will sometimes go on a tangent about what he is talking about and sometimes doesn't explain things very clearly. However, he does post his lectures online and has review sessions which are very helpful. His grading is also relatively easy. Take if you can learn yourself.

Christian Hilty was a horrible teacher. He likes to ramble on about chem related topics that are not related to the class which just confuses most students. I completely relied on tutoring to get me a B, the teacher didn't teach me anything. I don't wish anybody to have him as a teacher. I am very studious and did good in other classes.
He explains barely anything and he is bad at lecturing. He makes me despise chemistry. The class is way too hard for his teaching skills. Don't take.

Avoid Dr.Hilty. He fails at engaging the class, does not thoroughly explain difficult concepts, and quizzes often include material that is not presented or elaborated on in the lecture. His quiz average is always below 80 and does not curve any tests or quizzes. As someone who loves chemistry, he has assisted me in hating this subject now. AVOID!

Professor Hilty is a terrible teacher, don't get me wrong. His class does not help explain the concepts learned in this class, and I'm always left confused after his lectures. He is very nice, however. He gave me like two extensions on a quiz after I lost a family member, which was greatly appreciated.

I think Hilty gets too much criticism. He covers all of the content in lectures, but he doesn't really cover examples that are on the tests/quizzes. The TA review sessions are good for that. Really nice guy, and will do his best to help you if you come to him with questions. People who think he's bad clearly haven't had terrible teachers before.
horrible lectures, but class would randomly start clapping a few times every class so it was really fun lol.

Dr. Hilty cares for your success. There are countless resources to help you succeed. Go to the lectures and MAKE SURE you go to the review sessions and watch his videos on hard concepts. Gave like 30 points of extra credit so far. Don't expect an easy A, as that mindset is very dangerous going into his course. The workload is fair. Ask questions!!!

Hilty is very hard to understand and often rambles about non-related topics during lectures. He talks very fats and doesn't explain iClicker questions. The quizzes and tests are alright if you study, because the lectures don't help much.
I am taking this class and am not grasping any of the concepts. He is great if you're good with thick accents and ok with high pressure of tests. 1/5
Terrible in lectures. Doesn't explain concepts well and flies through lectures. A good TA will make or break your grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He was a cool dude but his class was hella difficult. The lectures had little to nothing to do with the tests and quizzes and were purely theoretical.

Hilty was a nice professor, but his lectures were hard to follow. I didn't take AP Chem so as a first-time Chem student this class was hard. S.I. sessions were the only way that I understood the course.

Doctor Hilty is a really nice guy, but he just wasn't a great lecturer. If you struggled with chemistry in high school, I wouldn't recommend taking him, but if you did well in AP chem then you'll probably be fine. The second half of the class is much harder than the first so watch out for the quizzes.

Dr. Hilty is a very nice guy and he is very knowledgeable but he is not the best lecturer. Chemistry 107 is a hard class, and there is no way to get around that. Most of the learning came from the homework for me because the lectures were not very clear. This class is definitely doable but it requires a lot of work.

Absolutely incredible human being, but a lot of homework, quizzes/exams make up majority of the grade with no partial credit, and it's hard to gage what you need to know for the quizzes/exams so you end up needing to study a lot.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: His lectures were very slow and didn't explain things. I learned outside of class by doing the homework problems. You never knew how to prepare for quizzes/tests because lectures were incomplete. He's a nice guy but avoid if possible.

Smart Guy, terrible teacher. The only learning opportunity was the homework, lectures were completely useless but daily questions meant you had to go. Seems to care about students but that only goes so far when he cant teach in general.

Dr. Hilty is tough to listen to in class, but he does care about his students. I had very limited chemistry knowledge coming into this class. The assessments are tough because they are online & have no partial credit. However, I received an A on the final exam after studying 30 hours, & he rounded my class grade to an A. He appreciates hard work.

Hilty does not have very good lecture skills. He is unable to control the class and he rambles on and on about irrelevant bits of information. I got an A in this class merely on my high school AP Chemistry knowledge.

Dr. Hilty is no doubt a professor that cares, but if you are able to choose another professor you should do so. He is very knowledgeable in what he does and teaches but he has no idea on how to explain himself. He is a slow lecturer as well and doesn't tell you what will be on exams/quizzes. There is also no extra credit or curve in this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: You can tell he is nice and cares about his students, but he is AWFUL at teaching. Almost all of your learning is done on your own, and he is terrible at explaining concepts. Find another prof for CHEM107 if you can.

If youve taken AP chem in HS, then the class wont be too big of a problem, but if you havent, good luck.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Hilty is a great human and knowledgeable in chemistry, but he is a terrible teacher. Most lectures you sit there and wonder what is going on. reviews.comment: His lectures are uninformative. He switches between slides too quickly for me to both take notes and comprehend them. Probably one of the worst teachers I have ever had, you need to teach yourself everything, Dr. Hilty is not a good lecturer and the slides that he uses to teach are of little to no use. The quizzes are very difficult and you don't know what to expect on them because the lectures in class are so vague. Please do not take Hilty for Chem

Quizzes are unforgiving, dont listen to people saying he curves, he doesnt.

Overall average+ professor. He is VERY knowledgeable, but does not always do the best job communicating new topics, jumping straight into the minor details before the base concepts. This class is hard, but an A is definitely doable if you take time to study outside of class. Go to lecture, take notes, then go study individually.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

He lets crowd noise affect him a ton which makes class hard to pay attention in.

reviews.comment: Hilty wasn't the best lecturer. His explanations can often be very vague, but he does answer questions rather well. Attendance is taken via a poll, which you, also have to be to receive access to.

reviews.comment: I try to give teachers the benefit of the doubt, but Hilty simply does not teach well at all. Lots of stuttering and very bad at explaining important course materials. Most of the learning is on your own and youll have a very difficult time without a heavy background in chem.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I am not one to bash on professors, but do not take Hilty. He does not teach well, I did not take chem in highschool nor did my friends and we hardly ever knew what was going on in class, he does not give many practice problems and the ones he does are clicker questions. You can barely understand him and his writing is illegible. This class sucked.

His lectures are very slow, so he is always having to cram content right before a quiz or exam. No partial credit on quizzes or exams makes it difficult to do well on them. If you haven't taken AP chem and take Hilty, all I can say is good luck or find someone else who teaches and answers questions more efficiently and clearly.

I don't understand anything he talked about during his lecture, but you have to attend them for a grade. He also talks very quietly so if you don't sit on the right side of the room you can't even hear him. Also doesn't explain concepts or problems well if you don't understand them the first time he explains them. He'll just repeat what he said.

His lectures are hard to understand and he doesn't explain things well. Examples questions given in lecture are not helpful, they don't prepare you for hw/quiz/test questions. He makes an already hard class much harder, especially for people who didn't take AP chem in high school

reviews.comment: This class requires a lot of outside prep. You won't be able to get away with showing up to lecture with no studying beforehand. His class is doable, but you will need to be ready to put in more time than you expect.

reviews.comment: Dr. Hilty is a very nice professor and he curved our Exams. I struggled with the tests in this class but I still ended with a B. Lots of Homework but I didnt mind because it helped me learn. Practice tests are very similar to the real tests.

reviews.comment: His test are hard, but if you do the practice exams youll pass. Theres HW 3 days a week, and they can take awhile but they help. His lectures are a boring, but he demonstrates all the problems well, and hes always willing to help.

It could be that Dr. Hilty is better in person, but if you are taking chemistry online I wouldn't recommend him. Really only take him if you need someone to read the slides to you because that's basically what his lectures were. If you do take his class, basically just understand the problems on his practice tests and you will do fine on the exams.

I passed this class with a B, so it wasnt that bad. Just make sure you do the homework with 100% completion and go to SI sessions. Hilty does care about his students passing, and he added a curve to every exam we took, just make sure you study the material throughly.

Of all the profs to take Chem from at A&M, Hilty is not the worst, but he's not great either. Labs are easy but time-consuming. ALEKS is assigned several times throughout the week and is frustrating and time-consuming, but don't get behind. Lecture videos are well explained, but he can overexplain in class. I wouldn't recommend for your first chem.

reviews.comment: Great professor! He is so sweet and loves to help his students. Practice questions given before the test are super helpful so make sure to do them. Clicker questions and ALEKS can get annoying but make sure to do them since they make up a lot of your grade.

Dr. Hilty is a great professor! He gives generous curves on tests and provides great practice problems. He uses ALEKS, which can be a pain but you have to get it done. He also has clicker questions during lectures for attendance so definitely go to class, ask questions, and do the problems. He is a solid choice if you have previous knowledge.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Prof. Hilty is a great professor!! He is very knowledgable and cares about his students a lot. If you work hard, do the homework, and do the practice problems, you will do great in the class! I 100% recommend him as your Intro to Chem professor! You will learn a lot!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: Do not listen to the ratings!!! If you study hard, watch the lectures, go to Si sessions, and do the test reviews you will pass! Dr. Hilty is an incredible professor and if you pay attention in class you will understand the concepts. On top of all that he curves the test heavily, so do not stress. TAKE this professor you will not regret it.

reviews.comment: I loved having professor hilty as my chem 119 instructor. He does require aleks which can be very over loading at times when you have other classes home works due. He curves very generously.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Hilty really to be a good prof but it can be very hard to understand him in lecture and not get bored. That being said, understanding the practice exams he gives are how you'll get an A. My only studying from this class came from doing the practice exams until I got a 100 (you can take them multiple times, they aren't for a grade).
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Hilty was my favorite professor this year. He is so nice and really goes out of his way to make extra videos explaining tough concepts. A lot of people dont like him, but they dont even bother looking at the extra content he provides. If you pay attention and do the homework, youll do just fine, and youll have a sweet, funny professor.

Dr. Hilty is a better professor than he gets credit for. He knows what he's talking about and although his lectures aren't the most interesting, they get the job done. There is ALEKS homework due every week and clicker questions in class, but he doesn't assign excessive work . His tests are manageable and he posts practice questions before them.

Dr. Hilty is a great choice for CHEM 119! Although I was not really good at Chemistry he curves his exams and if you complete the homework assigned and do well in lab it is very easy to get a B or better.

Dr. Hilty is a very kind person but his class was not my favorite. I had to seek a lot of outside help to understand concepts that I felt he did not go through enough. The tests are just like the test reviews but the tests and test reviews are nothing like the day-to-day work. If you're like me, Aleks hw is annoying but it will help you learn.
Cares about his student's success. Fair grader, but understanding.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: I hated this class I came in with little to no knowledge and he fully went straight in. He never fully taught the material well. So I seemed outside tutoring.

Dr. Hilty is so nice, however his lectures are boring, he reads off the slides then works through practice problems and polling questions. Watch his lecture videos before class to help grasp the concept better. ALEKS is annoying and takes time to do. His test reviews are extremely similar to the test and he curves very generously. Solid choice
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Hilty is a fairly average professor. Classes consist of him reading off of slides, doing a few examples, and asking a few Reef Clicker questions (which is why I say attendance is mandatory). The tests tend to have fairly generous curves. He is very reliable in posting slides, videos, and practice tests. There are ALEKS homework Mon, Wed, Fri.

Dr. Hilty struggles with engaging his students. He is very smart and nice, but he has the tendency to ramble and often times stutters. In the lectures, some pieces of info needed for the HW is skipped over or not explained in enough detail. If you take him, get a tutor ASAP.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He is a nice guy and his lectures are alright. He isn't the most eloquent speaker and often rambles so its easy to get distracted or confused. The class was pretty mediocre, but the TA was cool.

Professor Hilty is a very smart guy who does not know how to teach the material. Chemistry is a very hard concept but professor Hilty only made it really hard to understand. He would curve his exams generously because the average was often pretty low. This is what happens when professors prioritize their research labs over their actual classes.

Hilty is the sweetest professor ever! Super nice and will listen to feedback or questions during lectures! The only thing I would say is that he skims over topics in lectures and test questions "dive deep". I'd recommend taking notes from the textbook and his lecture to pass. Overall, not the best lectures but probably the kindest chem proff!
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Sweetest man ever, and everything is curved in his class. However, that's not where my problem lies. He is used to teaching higher level classes, so taking him for an intro really sucked. He forgets that the students are not advanced and skips over the basic learning objectives. Really heavy hw load, tests don't match review, clicker questions.

Don't get me wrong, Professor Hilty seems like a very nice and sweet man. His lectures are not very engaging though, which made it hard to pay attention. Practice problems in class are similar to test questions. Class is clicker question heavy too, so you have to pay attention in class.

Hilty is not a great lecturer for a beginning chemistry class. He skips over a lot of the super basics that you need in your first intro chem class. I had AP credit coming in with a pretty good knowledge of chemistry and that is how I barely got by in this class. If you are not good at chemistry or haven't had AP before DON'T TAKE HIM.

Hilty goes through lecture with examples and explains just enough to get you started on the homework. Do all the homework and go to class for clicker question points! Mindtap quizzes weekly and 3 exams plus the final. I found SI sessions the most helpful. He's so into chemistry and cracks some jokes. There are better profs but he's a solid choice.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Hilty was a decent prof. He cares about his students, and does his best to explain things thoroughly. I went to SI almost every session and was able to get an A. However, his exams don't always match his mock exams, and sometimes I felt unprepared for the material that was on the exam. I got to learn a little about his research, which was cool.
Very hard chem professor. He does not communicate in office hours clearly, and does not seem to care very much. LOTS OF HOMEWORK with not very helpful lectures. I recommend a different professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I personally found the class to be easy because the concepts from the homework applied directly to the test, so I didn't study that much and made a good grade. reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: hes a really nice guy, but not too great as a prof. however, he does curve the tests and the overall class grade generously-my test averages were a B, C, D, and a C on the final, and i got a B on the class. homework, lab, and clicker questions are 50% of the grade pretty much. lots of homework, usually due at noon instead of midnight.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I ended up hating chemistry by the end of this course. Dr. Hilty reads straight from PowerPoint slides and his slides do absolutely nothing to help...I had to go to SI or outside tutoring in order to further understand the content. He'd explain it in such a complex way that never made sense to me. Most frustrating class I've ever had.

Despite what some people may say here, if you take Dr. Hilty, you are setting yourself up for success. He does get caught up in the technical aspects of his lectures, but his tests are just like the reviews and he gives plenty of resources for you to do well. Show up for clicker questions, do the homework, and consult the TA, and you will be fine!
Hilty curves his tests pretty well, but his lectures don't help it all. Did not learn anything from him only from the textbook and tutoring.
